## Change and scope

Describe the problem, resulting behavior, related issues and parent trackers. Use closing keywords only for issues whose entire scope this PR completes; use "Related to" for partial delivery.

## Validation and limits

Record exact-head tests, relevant local review evidence, failures and remaining limitations. Distinguish author qualification, independent review, CI, merge, deployment and user acceptance.

## Review and merge checklist

- [ ] Identify each affected issue and parent tracker; reconcile delivered, remaining and deferred scope against current GitHub evidence.
- [ ] Record tests and exact-head CI; keep unfinished qualification draft.
- [ ] Obtain Brian's explicit approval for this individual PR before merging.

After an approved merge, the merger completes the following in the affected issues (these boxes may remain unchecked during PR review):

- [ ] Re-read each affected issue/parent and latest comments immediately before editing; defer conflicting concurrent edits.
- [ ] Refresh the current summary with merged PR/revision links, evidence limits, remaining next action and completion criteria. Preserve prior summaries, decisions and failures under a dated history heading.
- [ ] Reconcile type/status/area labels without guessing status, taking claims or closing broad trackers on a partial merge. Read back every metadata edit.
- [ ] Close narrow issues only on completed scope or visible transfer of every remainder with acceptance criteria; link the resolving PR and remove open-workflow status labels on closure.
- [ ] Keep named-installation deployment and independent user acceptance pending unless separately evidenced. A merge or green CI alone does not establish either.
